object.description: Check out a branch whose name holds an HTML entity, open the Project Explorer and a Document Editor; then stop a merge from a branch with such a name in which an object is renumbered, and open the Resolve merge dialog. Expected: both status bars show the branch name as written, entity included, and the dialog's renumbered line shows the object IDs and branch name as written.
